Currency converter

19 October 2026 2 min read
Tools

Convert between currencies using todays central bank rates.

Mid-market rates from Frankfurter, which blends daily figures from central banks. Card and cash rates will be worse than this.

Tool

Press convert

Notes

  • One request per press of Convert, nothing cached, so it's always today's rate (or the last working day's, at weekends).
  • Rates update once a day, so it's no good for anything you'd actually trade on.
